semantics.reset: active-high asynchronous; posedge areset clears history to zero, reset dominates clock updates while asserted
semantics.initialization: No power-up value specified before reset; no RTL initial assignment
semantics.rollback: At clock edge, load train_history shifted left by one with train_taken in bit 0
semantics.prediction: At clock edge, shift current history left by one with predict_taken in bit 0
semantics.output: predict_history directly exposes the 32-bit stored history; bit 0 is youngest branch
semantics.inactive: Hold when neither training misprediction nor prediction valid; changes to inputs between edges do not update history except reset
semantics.throughput: One update per rising clock edge; no additional pipeline latency

numeric.format: unsigned 32-bit bit history, not an arithmetic counter
numeric.shift: Discard old bit 31; new bit i for i=1..31 comes from old bit i-1
numeric.rollback_width: Use low 31 bits of train_history followed by one train_taken bit; discard train_history[31]
numeric.rounding_saturation: Not applicable; fixed-width history truncation only

verification.oracle: Independent 32-element bit array with bit-by-bit update from prior state or training input
directed: reset during activity and deassertion without update
verification.random: Deterministic seeded random controls and 32-bit training histories compared after each edge
verification.checks: Explicit dev_tb top, Icarus -g2012 with finite shell timeout; testbench watchdog and fatal mismatches
